NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Lumen saves where you write each new entry so you can find it on the map. You can change or turn this off anytime.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lumen adds the photos and videos you choose to your entry.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Lumen uses the camera so you can take a photo straight into your entry.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock Lumen with Face ID instead of your passcode.
